newsitem.title: USA: RJR Nabisco Holdings Corp Q4 net rises.
newsitem.headline: RJR Nabisco Holdings Corp Q4 net rises.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Per share after payment of preferred. Per share on a fully diluted basis.

1995 net from international tobacco operations contributions include $87 million ($59 million aftertax) of costs and expenses incurred in connection with consolidation and relocation of the international tobacco operations.

1996 net from food includes non-recurring restructuring implementation expenses from the food business of $70 million ($33 million aftertax) for 1996 quarter, and $97 million ($46 million aftertax) for 1996 year.

1996 includes restructuring expense of $428 million ($241 million aftertax) in June 1996 in domestic and international food businesses of $353 million and $75 million, respectively. In addition, 1995 includes restructuring expenses of $154 million ($104 million aftertax) from domestic and international tobacco businesses of $100 million and $54 million, respectively.
1995 net includes $103 million ($67 million after tax of costs and expenses in connection with the debt exchange offers and consent solicitations completed in June 1995.
Income before extraordinary item per common and common equivalent share on a primary basis was $0.63 vs $0.10 for the quarter, $1.74 vs $1.58 for the year.

Per share $0.73 vs $0.60 excluding one-time items in both years. On same basis, net was $248 milllion vs $207 million. Items excluded are one-time expenses of $33 million aftertax or $0.10 a fully diluted common share related to restructuring program during second quarter. Q4 1995 results exclude aftertax one-time expenses of $163 million, or $0.49 a share fully duluted related to reorganization of tobacco business.
